lines.text: Through the Sky Arch! Thread the needle, folks!
The Sky Arch! Biggest rock in Paradise!
The pack's getting away! Time to find some speed!
Bringing up the rear, folks! But the race isn't over!
A long way back! Hit that boost, my friend!
Boost! Hold on to something!
Kaboom! That's the boost, folks!
The brontosaurus herd is out for a stroll! Aren't they lovely?
Mind the long necks, folks! They have the right of way!
Chip Showtime Sterling slides on by! And he waves to the crowd!
Chip takes the place! Somebody cue the spotlight!
Rocket Rae muscles her way past! Look at those biceps go!
Here comes Rocket Rae! Full power, no brakes!
Vivi glides past! Graceful as a swan, fast as a rocket!
And Vivi takes the place! Without a hair out of place!
The car line through the jungle canyon! Past the long necks!
Down the canyon road! Rocks on the left, dinos on the right!
Closing the gap! They're reeling them in, folks!
Catching up fast! Somebody's been eating their vegetables!
The gap is shrinking! Here they come!
The Cliff Gap! Fly, little car, fly!
Over the ravine! My heart's in my mouth, folks!
Side by side, folks! Nobody blink!
Wheel to wheel, wing to wing! This is racing!
Inches apart! I can't watch, but I can't look away!
Over the creek! Don't look down, the fish are watching!
Creek Jump! Splash-free, folks!
Ohhh, dropped a place! Plenty of island left, folks!
Lost a spot there! Time to dig deep!
Slipping back! Don't let them get away!
What a day in Paradise, folks! Sun, sea and supercharged engines!
Is it a car? Is it a boat? Folks, it's both, and more!
Look at them go! This is why I love my job!
Ladies and gentlemen, the race is on and the island is watching!
Remember, folks, the dinosaurs were here first! Be polite!
Car, boat, plane and submarine! One machine, four times the fun!
I'd race too, but my hat doesn't fit in the cockpit!
Step right up and watch the greatest race on the island!
Smell that jungle air, folks! A little bit volcano, a little bit dinosaur!
Keep your hands inside the vehicle at all times! Unless you're waving!
Every shape a machine can take, and they're taking them all at full speed!
Don't worry about the volcano, folks! It only rumbles on Tuesdays!
Here comes the final stretch! Who wants it most?
Back on the road and heading for home, folks!
The finish line is in sight! Give it everything!
The Sunken Gateway! Ancient stones, ancient secrets!
And they're off!
Go, go, go! Off they go, folks!
Green light! Put the pedal down!
Up, up and over! What airtime, folks!
Look at it fly! And that's with wheels!
Sticks the landing! Give that driver a hand!
Stuck it! Did you see that, ladies and gentlemen?
Big air, folks! Big, big air!
Lagoon Landing! Hope you packed your swimsuit!
Last place, but you finished! Next time, more boost!
Somebody has to bring up the rear! Better luck next race, folks!
Ohhh, last across the line! Step right up and try again!
A new leader, folks! Hold on to your hats!
Out in front! Did you see that pass?
And the lead changes hands! What a race!
Round and round and right side up again! Spectacular!
The loop-the-loop! Don't look down... or up!
Upside down at full throttle! Marvelous!
Loop-de-loop! Gravity takes a holiday, folks!
Ohhh, not enough speed for the loop! Back you go!
Not enough speed! The loop wins this round!
Halfway up and back down again! Try it with more boost!
Into the Mangrove Run! Mind the roots, folks!
Twisting through the swamp! It's a jungle in there!
Close, but no cigar! That's a three second penalty!
Ohhh, just wide of the gate! Penalty time, folks!
Ohhh! So close, folks! Try again, try again!
Missed the gate! Three seconds in the penalty box, folks!
So close to the gate! The judges say penalty!
Look at the nests! Dino eggs as big as beach balls!
Past Chip Sterling! Sorry Chip, the show goes on!
Chip gets passed! That's not in his script, folks!
Right past Rocket Rae! Rae won't like that one bit!
And Rocket Rae gets left in the dust!
Past Vivi! Elegant, but not fast enough!
Vivi gets overtaken! She'll be furious, darling!
It's a photo finish! Somebody get me a camera!
Neck and neck to the line! Too close to call!
A long-neck in the lagoon! Say hello, folks!
Something big is swimming down there! Don't splash it!
A podium finish! Step right up and take a bow!
Not first, but on the podium! The crowd still loves you!
A fine finish, folks! A prize from the middle shelf!
Pterodactyls overhead! Watch your windscreen, folks!
Flying with the pterodactyls! They want a race!
Raptors running alongside! Are they racing too?
Those raptors are keeping up! Drive faster, please!
Thank you, thank you! Come back for the next race, folks!
Step right up and see the results!
And there we have it! What a race, ladies and gentlemen!
Oops! Not a winner this time, but don't go away!
Ooh, a sneaky shortcut! I didn't see a thing, folks.
Through the secret passage! Clever, clever!
The secret way! Don't tell the others, folks!
Fossils in the walls, folks! Don't end up as one!
Into the creek! A little swim never hurt anyone!
Swimming isn't racing, folks! Back you go!
Ladies and gentlemen, start your engines! And your wings! And your propellers!
Step right up, folks! Four racers, one lap, and every shape a machine can take!
Welcome to Paradise Plunge! Road, sky, lagoon and the deep blue below!
Hold on to your helmets! Paradise Plunge is about to go wild!
No wings for this one! Keeping it on four wheels!
Who needs wings? Not this daredevil!
Staying a car! Down the canyon road we go!
Splashdown! Now it's a boat!
Hull down, engines roaring, it's boat time, folks!
Into the lagoon with a splash! Who brought towels?
Ahoy there! Full speed ahead through the water!
Wheels down! Back on the blacktop, folks!
And it's a car again! Rubber meets the road!
Out of the water and onto the road! What a machine!
Four wheels and a dream, ladies and gentlemen!
Wings out! Up, up and away!
It's a plane now, folks! Mind the pterodactyls!
Off the ramp and into the sky! Spectacular!
Look at it soar! The clouds are jealous, folks!
Down periscope! It's a submarine!
Diving deep into the flooded caves, folks!
Into the deep blue, where the fishies don't pay rent!
Hatches sealed! Glub glub, ladies and gentlemen!
Look out for the T. rex! Don't feed it, folks!
Is that T. rex smiling? I think it's smiling!
The king of the cliffs is watching! Wave, but not too much!
One racer, one clock, no excuses! Let's see that time, folks!
The clock is ticking, folks! Every second counts on this island!
Triceratops in the mangroves! Three horns and zero patience!
Steer clear of the triceratops, folks! They don't do selfies!
Up a place! Keep it coming!
Climbing the order, folks! Who can stop them?
Another place gained! The crowd loves a comeback!
The Coral Vault! Glowing crystals and things that go bump!
Down in the deep! Watch those arches, folks!
Ooh! That's gonna leave a mark!
Bonk! The wall wins that round, folks!
Mind the scenery, it was here first!
Ooh! The scenery fights back, folks!
Boing! Somebody check the paintwork!
That's gonna cost a few seconds!
Through the waterfall! Free car wash, folks!
Bursting through the falls! Spectacular!
Abi takes it! The crowd goes wild!
Winner, winner! We have a winner!
Step right up and see the champion! Winner, winner!
Winner, winner! Somebody light the fireworks!
And the crowd goes WILD! Step right up and see a champion, folks!
Chip Showtime Sterling wins it! Showtime indeed!
Player two takes the crown! Winner, winner!
Rocket Rae takes the chequered flag!
Vivi wins! What a performance, folks!
Wings out! The scenic route over the lake!
It's a car! It's a plane! It's both, folks!
The scenic route! Over the lake through the golden rings!
